description: Fail-closed qualification gate for mandatory agent runtimes and framework expansions.

gates.requirement: Core installation excludes unrelated provider and sandbox extras.
Android and Termux installation is reproducible without uncontrolled source builds.
Required tasks succeed using the same model where comparison is possible.
Startup latency and peak memory stay within an approved target budget.
Prompt and tool-schema costs are measured and stay within an approved budget.
Provider requests, retries, and repeated context do not amplify materially.
Platform-native adapters remain first-class and independently replaceable.
Authority is explicit, bounded, and at least as strong as the protected baseline.
Engine and actuator layers retain independent rollback paths.
Missing optional support remains an honest, nonfatal state.
Security maintenance and provenance can be reproduced and recovered offline.
Measured capability gain exceeds dependency, token, security, and operational cost.
